primary_authority.citation: T. A. Wagner, S. Schlamminger, J. H. Gundlach, E. G. Adelberger, Class. Quantum Grav. 29 (2012) 184002, arXiv:1207.2442
primary_authority.content: Primary Eot-Wash WEP analysis gives a 95% CL vector-Yukawa bound for q_tilde=N=B-L as a function of lambda in Fig. 6, derived from Be-Ti/Be-Al lab-fixed differential accelerations and a geophysical source model.
primary_authority.normalization: alpha_tilde = g_tilde^2/(4*pi*G*u^2) in magnitude for vector exchange
primary_authority.conversion_note: Using G_N=6.70883e-39 GeV^-2 and u=0.93149410242 GeV. Thus g_BL = 2.70463357586823e-19*sqrt(|alpha_tilde|) when the paper's dimensionless B-L charge convention is identified with the frozen g_BL current convention.

materialization_route.plan: Recover the primary arXiv/publisher vector figure/source and extract the EW Fig. 6 path with calibrated log axes; validate conversion and endpoints against primary text/table. Do not raster-digitize by eye.

secondary_validation_only.role: Locator/regression target only; explicitly not accepted as 0072 primary authority.
secondary_validation_only.guard: Agreement with this secondary numeric curve is necessary as a regression cross-check but never sufficient for PASS.

low_mass_fifth_force.coverage_note: The frozen lower mass edge 1e-6 eV corresponds to a force range of about 0.197 m. MICROSCOPE alone is not a valid sole controller at this edge; finite-range Eot-Wash/ISL-class authority is required.

short_range_isl_crosscheck.primary_example: D. J. Kapner et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 98, 021101 (2007), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.98.021101
short_range_isl_crosscheck.scope: Primary torsion-balance inverse-square-law data at 55 micrometers to mm scales; constrains generic Yukawa gravity-strength alpha, not automatically the exact frozen B-L charge coupling.
short_range_isl_crosscheck.guard: Do not promote a composition-independent ISL alpha curve to g_BL without explicitly freezing source/test B-L charge-to-mass factors.

direct_detection_route.primary_authority: V. De Romeri, D. K. Papoulias, C. A. Ternes, JHEP 05 (2024) 165, arXiv:2402.05506
direct_detection_route.evidence: The paper publishes the Poissonian chi-square structure and nuisance treatment for LZ/PandaX-4T, while PandaX publicly releases experimental spectra/background components. This makes an independent same-convention reproduction plausible for at least the PandaX component.
direct_detection_route.guard: A reproduced individual experiment contour does not by itself close the full 1e-6 eV--10 GeV global interval.

next_actions: Attempt primary vector/source extraction of Eot-Wash B-L Fig. 6 and validate against the frozen secondary regression target without using it as authority.
In parallel, recover/reproduce a primary PandaX/LZ/XENONnT B-L direct-detection contour using released experiment data and the De Romeri likelihood convention.
Audit Esseili-Kribs BBN/CMB and Hong-Shin-Yun stellar source products for author code/tables before considering independent reproduction.
